correctness.rationale: The nine displayed degree<=2 spherical harmonic basis polynomials span the correct 9-dimensional space and are evaluated with radially normalized corners (±1,±1,±1)/sqrt(3). For each of all 1001 ten-node and 364 eleven-node subsets, a nonzero mod-97 rank-9 minor certifies rank nine in characteristic zero; independent modular Gaussian elimination reproduced 956 rank-nine/45 rank-eight ten-sets and 364 rank-nine eleven-sets. Exact Q(sqrt3) null vectors for the four representative ten-node masks, all directly substituted and checked, and the verified signed-permutation orbits (6,24,12,3) provide characteristic-zero upper rank eight for precisely all 45 deficient cases. Independent sign-coordinate substitutions verify the witnesses; no random sample was used.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Same-node all-degree results concern parity-compatible exact-degree full-grid sampling, not cumulative-band erasure subsets; randomized spherical reconstruction guarantees do not imply this worst-case deterministic matroid.

limitations: No noise conditioning or arbitrary perturbations; only specified 14 nodes and degree<=2, exact real/complex noiseless samples.
